description: Browse all artworks in a Met Museum department by department ID, with pagination. Returns a page of object IDs — use met.details to fetch full artwork metadata for each ID. Use met.departments to get department IDs (e.g. 10=Egyptian Art, 11=European Paintings, 21=Modern Art). CC0 public domain (Met Museum)

department_id.description: Department ID to browse. Use met.departments to get IDs. Examples: 10=Egyptian Art, 11=European Paintings, 13=Greek and Roman Art, 21=Modern Art

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based, default 1). Each page returns up to 100 object IDs.

per_page.description: Number of object IDs per page (1–100, default 50). Use with met.details to fetch artwork metadata.

name: met.collection.browse

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Browse Met Museum Department
